testResults.name: Thesis-lake-and-harness-clients
testResults.result: 9 tests passed for point-in-time lake requests, local process/API adapters, authenticated remote adapters, manifest/metrics/artifact preservation, capability reporting, and unavailable harness behavior.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed; adapters do not import quant engine internals and credentials are redacted from representations.

decisions: Local and remote adapters share published lake and harness contracts while keeping transport selection outside domain records.
Missing capabilities are returned as unavailable reports rather than silently emulated.
